tools.name: list_equipment
tools.description: List FotoRent camera gear for pickup in Diemen, Amsterdam area. Optional category filter.

tools.name: get_equipment_details
tools.description: Get prices, verified mount and kit contents, specs, availability snapshot and booking links.

tools.name: get_rental_quote
tools.description: Estimate a listing's rental, Gearbooker fee and total. Return day is free; applies minimum, Friday-to-Monday and weekly pricing. Returns a shareable quote URL; final checkout is on Gearbooker.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Check both pickup and return dates against a fresh calendar snapshot. Returns available_in_snapshot, blocked or unknown. Without dates, lists known blocked dates; never reserves gear.

tools.name: how_to_rent
tools.description: Pickup address, hours, booking process, insurance, rental limits and contact for questions.

tools.name: start_booking
tools.description: Get the Gearbooker booking link and a FotoRent quote page. This only returns links: no booking, account or payment is created. Optional paired dates preserve the estimate on FotoRent.

tools.name: check_compatibility
tools.description: Check a rental lens against the client's camera mount. Unknown or unverified mounts require confirmation; fixed-lens cameras cannot take interchangeable lenses.

tools.name: quote_kit
tools.description: Estimate selected listings together. Rejects duplicate or already-included gear. Multi-listing fees are the sum of separate estimates; shared inventory and combined checkout require confirmation.

tools.name: recommend_kit
tools.description: Suggest up to three real kits for portrait, events, interview, travel, instant or FPV, respecting dates, minimum rental and total budget. Optional owned_camera_mount returns compatible lenses for a client's own camera. Over-budget alternatives are labelled explicitly; availability is a snapshot, not
